_comment: Mutation testing (v1.5.2 tooling). Stryker mutates the source, re-runs the suite per mutant, and reports which mutations the tests FAIL TO NOTICE — the one question a green suite cannot answer. Scoped to the pure, record-critical modules: they hold the calibration and export maths, and their unit tests are fast enough to run thousands of times. ui/ is deliberately absent — it is only reachable through the Electron e2e suite, which is far too slow to mutate.
